description: Admins: permanently erase one person's personal data from this workspace — by contact id or by phone number (destination), including inbound callers who are not contacts. Removes the contact, its activity history, and every call's recording, transcript, outcome, number and linked action/handoff content. Calls keep only time, status, duration and cost. Refused while a call with them is active or one of their actions is unresolved. With doNotCall (always, if they had opted out) a one-way fingerprint of the number keeps them from being called or answered again. Use for data-subject erasure requests; download the audit first if you need to answer an access request.

destination.description: Erase by number, e.g. an inbound caller who is not a contact.

doNotCall.description: Keep the number on this workspace's do-not-call list as a one-way fingerprint. Always kept when the contact had opted out.

id.description: The contact to erase. Give this or destination, not both.

name: contacts_erase
